title: Executable Protocol Engine
tests: focused: frozen protocol compiles and runs deterministically on synthetic devices
focused: dry_run validates without acquiring; compiled plan is ordered
focused: protocol_record and experiment_run records validate against their JSON schemas
modes: REAL is PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN with no artifacts; FAULT_INJECTION stops on fault; REPLAY re-emits frames
stop conditions: MAX_ACQUISITIONS terminates the run (limit of 2 and of 1)
determinism: same seal + config + seed yields byte-identical run hash; different seed changes readings; freeze is deterministic
negative: post-seal edit produces a new hash and is refused; a tampered SealedProtocol fails verify() and is refused at compile time
negative: unauthorized configuration and unavailable capability refused before acquisition; missing calibration refused
negative: measurement-class claim cap refused; acquisition without maneuver refused; synthetic run not readable as a measurement
negative_results: No protocol was executed against a real device; every REAL-mode run is recorded as PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN with zero raw artifacts.
No physical measurement was produced. A SYNTHETIC or REPLAY run yields a SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION, reproducible from the seed, never a PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT.
A protocol may not cap its claim at a measurement class; Protocol._validate_claim_cap refuses PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT and every other measurement class at construction.
An edited protocol cannot masquerade as the frozen one: refuse_edit_after_seal detects the changed hash, and compile_plan refuses a broken seal.
A configuration not authorized for a step's capability is refused before any acquisition; no acquisition occurs under an unheld authority.
reopening_test: python -m pytest tests/v8/test_protocols.py -q  # this phase reopens if any of the 31 tests fails, if a synthetic/replay ExperimentRun ever carries a measurement-class claim_class, if a REAL-mode run produces raw artifacts or a status other than PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN, if compile_plan executes against a broken seal, or if a Protocol accepts a measurement-class claim_cap.
acceptance_checklist: Required outputs r15/protocols.py and r15/protocol_runner.py present: PASS
Protocol is frozen (seal + hash) before execution and edits after seal are detected: PASS
Execution against synthetic devices is deterministic under a seed: PASS
A REAL run is PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN: PASS
Execution refused if the config is unauthorized or the protocol seal is broken: PASS
REAL, REPLAY, SYNTHETIC, and FAULT_INJECTION modes kept distinct: PASS
Records conform to protocol_record.schema.json and experiment_run.schema.json: PASS
Privacy scan passes (synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs): PASS
Reuses R13 authorities (serialize, preregister, experiments); no duplicate truth systems: PASS

claims.statement: The protocol engine compiles a frozen, hash-sealed protocol into an ordered, deterministic sequence of authorized steps.
Executing a frozen protocol against synthetic devices under a seed produces a reproducible ExperimentRun of synthetic observations.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
